source.title: System Design Interview – An Insider's Guide (2nd Edition)
source.description: Chapter scaffolding inspired by Alex Xu's book. Contains only original summaries and original interactive diagrams — no book text or images.

chapters.title: Scale From Zero To Millions Of Users
chapters.description: The scaling journey: single server → load balancing → replication → caching → CDN → stateless tier → multi-datacenter → queues.

sections.title: Overview
sections.contentMarkdown: Our original walkthrough of how a single-server app evolves into a system serving millions of users. Work through the interactive diagrams in order: each one adds a component (load balancer, replicas, cache, CDN, message queue) and explains why it becomes necessary.

chapters.title: Back-of-the-Envelope Estimation
chapters.description: Powers of two, latency numbers, availability math, and quick capacity estimates.

sections.title: Overview
sections.contentMarkdown: Practice quick capacity math: QPS, storage, bandwidth, and cache sizing from first principles.

chapters.title: A Framework For System Design Interviews
chapters.description: A repeatable 4-step approach: understand the problem, propose a high-level design, deep dive, wrap up.

sections.title: Overview
sections.contentMarkdown: A 4-step method for any design question: clarify requirements and scale, agree on a high-level blueprint, deep-dive the interesting components, then summarize trade-offs and follow-ups.

chapters.title: Design A Rate Limiter
chapters.description: Token bucket, leaking bucket, sliding windows; where the limiter lives and how counters are shared.

chapters.title: Design Consistent Hashing
chapters.description: Hash rings, virtual nodes, and minimizing key movement when servers join or leave.

chapters.title: Design A Key-Value Store
chapters.description: CAP trade-offs, data partitioning, replication, quorum consensus, and failure handling.

chapters.title: Design A Unique ID Generator In Distributed Systems
chapters.description: Multi-master sequences, UUIDs, ticket servers, and snowflake-style IDs.

chapters.title: Design A URL Shortener
chapters.description: Hashing vs base-62 encoding, redirect flows, and read-heavy caching.

chapters.title: Design A Web Crawler
chapters.description: URL frontier, politeness, dedup, content storage, and crawl traps.

chapters.title: Design A Notification System
chapters.description: Push/SMS/email fan-out through provider gateways, queues, retries, and rate limiting.

chapters.title: Design A News Feed System
chapters.description: Fan-out on write vs read, feed cache layers, and ranking pipelines.

chapters.title: Design A Chat System
chapters.description: WebSocket connections, message sync across devices, presence, and group chat fan-out.

chapters.title: Design A Search Autocomplete System
chapters.description: Trie-based suggestion serving, top-k aggregation, and data-gathering pipelines.

chapters.title: Design YouTube
chapters.description: Video upload/transcoding pipelines, CDN delivery, and metadata at scale.

chapters.title: Design Google Drive
chapters.description: File chunking, sync conflicts, block storage, and notification of changes.
